title: Stored work
description: A stored work of a profile, works/<profile id>/<attempt id>.json, which app writes beside api.zip as GetWork gave it.

format.description: The version of the part, the integer in export/VERSION.

profile_id.description: The ID of the profile whose work it is.

attempt_id.description: The attempt whose work it is.

kind.description: What the work is, as api set it.

stored_at.description: When api kept the work, the last time it was put.

history.description: The history of writing as the canvas gave it, the JSON array its bytes hold, not their base64: write/erase/cut/clear/undo events with t, a cut with the pieces it left; strokes with id, kind, style and points x, y, t, p.

items.description: A submission's context, as the canvas gave it, and the history length when it was sent: one of them.

submissions.description: Each submission of the attempt, in order: its context, as the canvas gave it, and the history length when it was sent.

picture.description: The picture of the work: the PNG of the strokes the surface shows at the end, in base64 by the standard alphabet of RFC 4648, not base64url.
